name: Customer support
description: Draft replies in your brand tone, write FAQs, sort and tag exported tickets and summarise customer feedback. Replies are drafts; nothing is ever sent for you.

sampleTasks.title: Draft replies to three customer complaints about late delivery
sampleTasks.description: Using the three messages I paste in, draft calm, honest replies in our brand tone that apologise, explain next steps and avoid promises we cannot keep.

sampleTasks.title: Compose an FAQ page for a small online shop
sampleTasks.description: Draft ten frequently asked questions and answers about shipping, returns and payment for an invented online shop selling hand-made candles, from the policy notes I provide.

sampleTasks.title: Sort last week's exported tickets by topic and urgency
sampleTasks.description: Take the ticket export in the folder I name, tag each ticket by topic and urgency, and list the three most common problems.
